relations.statement: For any matrix M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (GaussianRational), if M is Hermitian then its entries lie in Q(i).
relations.hypotheses: M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) GaussianRational ∧ Hermitian M

relations.statement: The finite time‑sliced kernel construction does not assert existence of a continuum path‑integral measure.

lemmas.statement: The scattering matrix S constructed from the Hermitian reaction matrix over Q(i) is unitary.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem S_unitary_from_hermitian {n : Nat} (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (GaussianRational)) (hR : Hermitian R) : IsUnitary (S_from_R R) :=
  sorry

lemmas.statement: Refusal to assert a continuum measure entails that the action functional is defined only on finite time‑sliced configurations.

open_obligations: Provide a concrete Lean definition of HermitianMatrix_Qi compatible with existing matrix libraries.
